features.name: Agentic Planning Loop
features.description: Upgrade AI Query API from single-turn to multi-step agentic analysis with planning, execution, and synthesis phases

test_steps.action: Send query: 'Why is Engineering attendance dropping?'
test_steps.expected: AI shows step-by-step progress (Checking data... Analyzing trends...)
AI returns structured response with: summary, findings, evidence, recommendations
Audit log shows multiple tools called in sequence
AI asks for clarification rather than guessing
AI only accesses and returns data for that Principal's college

features.name: Conversation Memory
features.description: Persistent conversation history with context-aware follow-ups

test_steps.expected: AI responds with Engineering attendance data
AI understands context, shows 'Based on our attendance discussion, here is Nursing...'
Previous conversation preserved, AI remembers context

test_steps.action: As Director, view another user's conversation history
test_steps.expected: Director can see all conversations

test_steps.action: As Principal, try to view Director's conversation
test_steps.expected: Access denied, can only see own conversations

features.name: Progress Updates
features.description: Real-time step-by-step progress for queries taking >10 seconds

test_steps.action: Send complex query requiring multiple data sources
test_steps.expected: UI shows animated progress steps as each tool executes
Steps are human-readable: 'Checking attendance data...' not technical
Updates appear within 3-5 seconds of each other
Progress UI displays correctly on mobile

features.name: Management System Prompts
features.description: Role-aware system prompts that provide executive-style responses

test_steps.action: Send same query as Director and as VP
test_steps.expected: Director gets institution-wide view, VP gets department view
Response includes: Executive summary, Key metrics, Concerns, Actions
Uses 'learners' not 'students', 'learning facilitators' not 'teachers'
AI responds in Tamil while maintaining professional tone

features.name: Daily Morning Briefing
features.description: Automated 6 AM briefing with metrics, anomalies, and predictions

test_steps.expected: Briefing generates with all 4 sections: metrics, vs targets, anomalies, predictions

test_steps.action: Check Director's briefing vs Principal's briefing
test_steps.expected: Director sees institution-wide, Principal sees only their college
In-app notification delivered between 6:00-6:05 AM
Opens AI Assistant with briefing displayed

test_steps.action: Test on day with no anomalies
test_steps.expected: Briefing still generated with 'No anomalies detected' section

features.name: Predictive Concerns
features.description: AI predicts future problems based on trend analysis

test_steps.expected: Shows specific section and date when 75% threshold will be breached

test_steps.expected: Shows amount at risk and deadline

test_steps.action: Ask AI: 'What issues should I watch for this month?'
test_steps.expected: AI provides consolidated prediction across all domains

test_steps.expected: Returns ranked table with all colleges
Each college shows: vs target, vs last year, vs peer average

test_steps.expected: Drill-down to detailed view of that college

features.name: Show Sources on Request
